title: machaerina gunnii
intro: Machaerina gunnii, commonly known as the swamp sedge, is a plant species in the family Cyperaceae. The health benefits of Machaerina gunnii include its ability to exhibit anti-inflammatory properties, which may aid in reducing swelling and pain. The bioactive constituents of Machaerina gunnii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
